name: Python Inline Command Execution
description: Detects execution of python using the "-c" flag. This is could be used as a way to launch a reverse shell or execute live python code.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Python libraries that use a flag starting with "-c". Filter according to your environment
query: ((process.pe.original_file_name:python.exe OR (process.executable:(*python.exe OR *python3.exe OR *python2.exe))) AND process.command_line:*\ \-c*) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:C\:\\Program\ Files\\Python* AND process.parent.executable:*\\python.exe AND process.parent.command_line:*\-E\ \-s\ \-m\ ensurepip\ \-U\ \-\-default\-pip*)) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:*\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\Microsoft\ VS\ Code\\Code.exe OR (process.command_line:*\<pip\-setuptools\-caller\>* AND process.command_line:*exec\(compile\(*)))
